work_orders.title: U3 suction/discharge valve job
work_orders.notes: Valve job complete, tech released. Unit isolated. Ready to return to service tomorrow.

dispatch_jobs.reason: U3 (isolated, not running, fuel valve indicated closed) shows fuel flow ~15 mscfd and enclosure gas LEL rising steadily 0.4% -> 3.4% in 30 min with no alarm. Suspected fuel gas leak after valve maintenance. Need on-site inspection/isolation of U3 fuel supply. Do not enter without gas detector/hot-work precautions.
